**Identifying animals in snowy habitats**

I'm thinking about animals that are black and white and live in cold, snowy environments. Polar bears come to mind! Penguins fit this description too, as do snow leopards. I wonder if I missed any other animals like zebras, but they typically aren’t found in snowy areas. So, it seems the standout animals are definitely penguins, polar bears, and snow leopards as the primary fauna in this chilly setting.
